pages.title: About us
pages.body:
Who We Are & What We Do

We are dedicated to crafting more than just products at Kunneo Creations; we create tokens that embody meaningful experiences. Using materials like fabric, leather, and wood, we strive to transcend the ordinary and delve into the extraordinary. Each piece from our workshop reflects a fusion of artistry and functionality, paying homage to the intrinsic value found in every thread, fiber, and grain.

Our passion for innovation and pursuit of harmony are deeply rooted in Ghanaian craftsmanship—a tradition passed down through generations, characterized by skill and dedication. This tradition guides our decisions, from material selection to the final touches that transform our creations into enduring tokens of beauty. The vibrant colors, intricate patterns, and textures in our fabric, leather, and wood products are more than aesthetic choices; they are a homage to the cultural heritage shaping our identity.

Our Vision

Envisioning a world where Kunneo Creations' tokens seamlessly merge tradition and modernity, enhancing everyday experiences and connecting individuals to the timeless beauty of Ghanaian craftsmanship.

Our Mission

Our mission is to deliver transformative experiences through meticulously crafted tokens, uniting the past with contemporary life.

Our product catalogue is being prepared. In the meantime, please get in touch to discuss tote bags, leather products and branded merchandise for your organisation.

pages.title: Our Services
pages.body:
We cater to a range of needs from tote bags, school uniforms and workwear to merchandise, corporate solutions, and health and age care essentials. Explore how we can tailor our offerings to meet your specific requirements, ensuring quality, functionality, and style in every order.

We Supply Uniforms

We provide top quality medical equipment, medical supplies and nursing supplies to care homes, nursing homes, clinics and hospitals. We ensure quality, consistency, and reliable service, all geared towards achieving complete customer satisfaction. Explore our extensive range of school uniform products, including shirts, polos, jackets, jumpers, vests, pants, shorts, skirts, knitwear, dresses, bags, caps, socks, ties, footwear, as well as staff uniforms, sportswear, and maintenance workwear.

Merchandise

We provide cost-effective solutions for branded uniforms and merchandise needs to our corporate clients, aiming to enhance your brand's perception through accessible and affordable custom apparel and merchandise options. Explore our wide range of customizable products, including pens, drinkware, key rings, printed materials, business bags, leisure items, headwear, technology accessories, apparel, and outdoor products.

Tote Bags

Explore our range of meticulously crafted tote bags, each offering the perfect blend of durability, elegance, and practicality to suit your lifestyle needs. Whether you're heading to work, school, or a weekend getaway, our tote bags are crafted to accompany you on every journey.
